description: Which weekday and 2-hour slot the audience of specific videos (or of every video in a folder) plays the most in a period. Weekday × 2-hour slot grid, summed over the period — the same grid as the dashboard heatmap (Analytics → Best times), with the hours exactly as Panda analytics stores them. An end_date of today counts only up to yesterday (the API clamps it). Returns {scope, start_date, end_date, metric, videos_count, best_slots: [{weekday, hours, total}] (top 10), by_weekday, by_hours, warnings}.

folder_id.description: Folder ID: uses every video in the folder (up to 5000). Use this OR video_external_ids.

metric.description: 'plays' = unique plays (dashboard default) or 'impressions' = unique player views

start_date.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: 30 days ago — always sent, since the API returns partial data without it.

video_external_ids.description: video_external_id of each video (field `video_external_id` from panda_list_videos / panda_get_video — NOT the `id`). Max 2000. Use this OR folder_id.

name: panda_get_best_times_by_videos
title: Get Best Times by Videos
